newsitem.title: USA: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on CME hog futures ranged from 0.100 cent per lb lower to 0.100 higher while pork belly calls ranged from 0.200 cent per lb lower to 0.200 higher, livestock analysts said.

Some analysts look for carryover technical weakness in hog and pork belly futures. Both markets appeared overbought after recent gains that stemmed from Taiwan's pork export ban and expected greater pork exports to Japan, sources said.
But other analysts look for support to develop in hogs on firmer-than-expected cash hog prices early Tuesday.
